## Procedure
Keep Kodi and FOSS add-ons separate from proprietary services; support local libraries and official integrations only; define full-screen routing, return-to-desktop escape, remote/input behavior, and network permissions.

## Verification
Fresh profile starts and exits cleanly, no piracy tooling is documented, licenses are classified, and media data remains user-controlled.
